description: amazing-race-monitor's vision review was designed to run as a fork, but a fork inherits the controller's model (glm-latest), which rejects image inputs (API 400 on first image Read). The rehearsal vision pass died before reviewing any media.
correction: Vision review must run as a general-purpose sub-agent pinned to a vision-capable model (model: sonnet), never as a fork. Re-ran the rehearsal review this way and it proceeded correctly.
systemic_fix: skills/amazing-race-monitor/SKILL.md vision-review section and the .claude wrapper now say explicitly: spawn a general-purpose sub-agent with model: sonnet for vision review, do NOT use a fork (fork inherits the controller model; glm-latest does not accept image inputs). General rule for capability-build: any skill step that renders images to the model must specify a vision-capable model for the executing sub-agent.
